en.topic_title: Owner arrested over fatal Yuen Long dog attacks, killer dog may be euthanised if not reclaimed
en.topic_summary:
The owner of a large dog suspected of mauling two smaller dogs to death in Yuen Long has been arrested.



Dot Park, a pet-friendly dog park in Yuen Long where one of the fatal attacks took place. Photo: Google Maps.



The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said in a statement on Tuesday night that it had arrested the owner of the dog earlier that day and collected a statement regarding the case.
